findings.title: Bankable PC accepted as fixed VDP OUT site
findings.observed: validate_features and instrumentation accept pc=0x03FF or0x1000 and only compare ROM file bytes; generated breakpoint commands have no live opcode guard.
findings.why: Official Sega mapper fixes only first1024bytes; laterbankchanges alter logical bytes0400–3FFF. An event can be labeled vdp_io_before_out at a site executing another instruction. Codemasters also prevents universal fixedlowbank assumption.
findings.recommendation: Require qualified mapper+fullyfixed2byte site, or validate exact live opcode bytes for every hit; preserve mismatch/skipped scope and count. Add a bank-switch negative fixture.

findings.title: Impossible VDP internal event values accepted
findings.observed: Complete rebound synthetic bundle with vcounter/hslot/address/cd=99999 passes audit.
findings.why: NoCPUresync permits stalephase, not values impossible for storedfieldtypes. vcounter is uint16,hslot/cd uint8 in vdp.h.
findings.recommendation: Validate source-type ranges for each raw internal field, without claiming CPU alignment; add negative event fixtures. Address is uint32, so use actual qualified bound or type scope rather than inventing14bit for internal state.

findings.title: Unknown WAVE format escapes structured audit result
findings.observed: A size-consistent WAVE with formatTag3 throws wave.Error through audit(), which catchesOSError/ValueError/TypeError/etc but notwave.Error.
findings.recommendation: Translate wave.Error to ValueError in wave_summary or catch explicitly in audit; return structured failed audit. Negative test formatTag3.

expected_limitations_not_findings.result: Accepted byaudit; intentional: observed_pc may be stale, so cannot demand equalPC. Definitionaddress identifies hooksite, not observedPC.

expected_limitations_not_findings: CPUwatch value is debugger read at trap, not committed bus value, exactwrittenaddress or complete2bytewrite payload.
VDP internalclock/address is not resynchronized toCPU and does not prove OUT commit or hardwarephase.
APNG nominal60Hz container is not throughput/logicFPS.
WAVE native mix is asynchronous, no frame-lock or musical-quality claim.
Maintenance expectedSHA is curator-manifest trust, not upstream signature; no autoqualification/pin change.
recommendation: ResolveBEX01 before promoting VDP_OUT applicability; closeBEX02/03 for strict record and JSON contracts. Existing source/record review does not qualify current runtime capture after helper change.
